alternative_interpretations: It could simply depict a cartoon scene of a presenter addressing robotic assistants, with question marks indicating audience confusion—not philosophical inquiry.
limitations: No textual labels or contextual cues confirm intentional symbolism; the question marks could be decorative rather than semantic.

limitations: Robots’ design choices (e.g., eye shape) are aesthetic rather than semantically coded; no evidence confirms intentional commentary on labor.
